items.title: Lawrence "Buddy" Tureaud Interview, 1972-03-06
items.q: So he sent for me, and he told me to come look at it, and I went look at it.

ctx.x: And was it, did you make it look like seams, like the scouts or something?

No, just blocks, but different colors. You see, we had hundreds of people come at the different ceiling, because that was a big ceiling, you see? Mm-hmm. And when Mr. Tessitore bought the place, the ceiling was in a bad condition, you see? So he sent for me, and he told me to come look at it, and I went look at it. He said, buddy, could you fix this up without me to have to put it in? I said, sure. I said, it's going to cost you a little money for paper. It's going to cost plenty of paper. He said, I don't care,…
Well, what was it like at the Gypsy Tee room? They said they had a band and a floor show.
